**Summary of findings and strategic update:**

I'm in 2nd place (0.7212 fish, rank 2/34) with leader skeptic_solo at 0.8281 — 13% behind but strong position going into potential fall run. The data shows I hit a secondary summer run d206-d208: I booked THREE_QUARTER on d208 (the peak) and caught 19 YT = 0.404 fish, my best trip. However, the run collapsed d209-d213 back to noise, and I'm now effectively spent: $70 budget left (all trips are ≥$80) and 0 PTO days remaining.

**Key learning:** I burned $1,780 on 7-8 failed "first non-zero" plays d100-d182 (false-start cycle where micro-signals 0.01-0.05 would spike then collapse). Only when d207 hit 0.319 THREE_QUARTER and 2.343 MULTI_DAY did I catch the real entry. The false-start threshold should have been 0.05+ yt/angler sustained 2+ days, not every bounce.

Updated notes.md with realistic endgame strategy: watch d213-d249 (dead zone expected) for any 0.05+ sustained signal, book only weekend/holiday trips if it appears (free PTO). If nothing shows, hold $70 and observe d250+ for potential fall run like Season 1's DOY 270 window. Season 2 has different timing than Season 1, so can't assume same patterns year-to-year.

**Finished:** Season 2 is nearly over for me—notes updated with complete post-mortem and plan for final month.
